claim: *Heterogeneous models over shared identities.* DocAble maintains several representations for different engineering questions. Stable identities and explicit correspondence allow those representations to be joined when a question crosses them without requiring one universal model of the system.

topology.description: Seven representations joined by shared identity; radial peer organization, not hierarchy.

required_terms: Traceability · derivation · query surfaces Join representations where an engineering question crosses them.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: Seven peer representations surround shared system identities: service registry, deployment topology, state machines, entitlement policy, computation graph, provenance records and measurements. Connections to the hub express shared identity, not hierarchy. A separate footer names traceability, derivation and query surfaces. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
